name: Voidrel
storyline: In the contested reaches of the void, species war over the last veins of mineral and plasma. Choose your people, raise a base from bare rock, and out-build, out-tech, and out-fight everyone who stands between you and control of the sector.
summary: Voidrel is a free real-time strategy game that runs entirely in the web browser, with no download or installation. Players choose one of six distinct species — each with its own units and playstyle — then gather resources, build a base, research technology, and command armies to defeat their opponents. It features casual matches, a ranked ladder across 1v1, 2v2, and 3v3 modes, Classic RTS mechanics — base-building, fog of war, a minimap, and unit control — in an instantly accessible browser package.
